judged_text: The category lookup `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` raises an exception when the SELECT returns no rows, so the `if category_id == 0` uncategorized fallback is unreachable dead code and db:migrate aborts. Any upgrading site whose `embed_category` setting is unset, blank (the default is ''), or does not exactly match an existing category name gets zero rows from the JOIN; `execute(...)[0]` then raises (IndexError on the PG::Result the code itself relies on via `cmd_tuples` at line 19, or NoMethodError on nil), crashing the migration and blocking the upgrade for the majority of sites instead of falling back to the uncategorized category as intended.
